planning_notes: Time-dependent behavior is required; the program uses elapsed_ms input (delta since previous step) to implement “increase once per second” for the TM1637 number. Model will maintain the displayed value and apply per-second increment gating.
No other wiring was specified beyond CLK=D4 and DIO=D5 for the TM1637. Supplied pins is empty, so no additional pin overrides are assumed.
Serial reporting is not explicitly required; no serial channels are created.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Delta time since previous control step (required for 1Hz increment of TM1637)

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: TM1637 four-digit display number, incrementing once per second
